name: Fallen Watchtower
description: An abandoned stone watchtower once used by Eldorian scouts, now occupied by the Red Sun goblin tribe.
visualTheme: Crumbling circular stone tower heavily fortified with crude wooden spikes and bone decorations.

history.createdWhy: Built during the Great Border War to safeguard the valley below.
history.builtWho: Scouts of the Eldorian Royal Guard.
history.majorEvents: Fell to the Red Sun tribe due to a surprise night attack.
history.whyExists: Serves as the main base of operations for goblin raids in the Whispering Wilds.
history.currentConflicts: The goblins are manufacturing weapons using black-market iron.
